newsitem.title: JAPAN: JSDA says to introduce OTC margin trading in Oct.
newsitem.headline: JSDA says to introduce OTC margin trading in Oct.

text.p: The Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Wednesday it would introduce margin transactions on the over-the-counter market in October in an attempt to raise the market's liquidity.
A JSDA official said it also plans to start a system of borrowing or lending stocks on the OTC market in July after revising its rules.

Margin transactions will be allowed only for stocks which have been registered on the OTC market for more than a year and have a volume of at least 10 million shares. The number of shareholders must also be more than 1,000.
